subject: social_studies
concept: Applying producer/consumer, goods/services, scarcity, jobs, and local/global trade to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple simulated marketplace featuring several producer roles, goods/services, and a scarcity constraint to solve
exercise.abstract: Student explains how their marketplace design addresses a scarcity problem fairly

assessment.mastery_threshold: design includes distinct producer/consumer roles and addresses the scarcity constraint reasonably
misconception_flags: design ignores the stated scarcity constraint entirely

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
